paragraphs: As part of a multidisciplinary delivery team, I helped build a full-stack, cloud-native AI application that modernises and automates maintenance strategy processes across Heavy Mobile Equipment and Fixed Plant assets. It replaces fragmented, manual engineering workflows with AI-augmented data review, statistical reliability modelling and data-driven maintenance optimisation.
bullets: Maintenance master data Human-in-the-loop review workflows for AI-generated material classifications, FLOC BOM validation and work order classification.
Reliability engineering Weibull analysis, MTBF/MTTF calculation, Asset Health Index scoring, component age analysis and replacement projection modelling.
Maintenance strategy optimisation Turning reliability outputs into data-driven maintenance tactic and component replacement recommendations for engineer sign-off.
Full-stack development React/TypeScript front-end features and Python/FastAPI REST endpoints.
Data engineering and cloud Databricks Gold-layer products and SAP work order data into PostgreSQL, deployed on Azure Container Apps.
Data visualisation Interactive reliability charts including Weibull curves, age analysis timelines and health index dashboards using Plotly.js.

experience.role: Group Asset Management Framework (Phase 1 & 2) · Consultant Engineer
bullets: Rolled out the group Asset Management Framework and System Definition, defining Key Practice Areas, system requirements and documentation layout.
Supported Asset Management System documentation and global standardisation.
Facilitated workshops with central and site asset management teams across Australia, Chile, South Africa, Ghana and Canada.

experience.role: Asset Health Index Rollout (Fixed Plant) · Consultant Engineer
paragraphs: Built and rolled out an Asset Health Index across two Pilbara sites on a 4/3 FIFO roster, covering wet plant assets and low-grade fixed plant.
bullets: Developed Power BI dashboards to track and communicate asset health scores across sites.
Worked with reliability engineers and site stakeholders to validate AHI scoring methodologies.
Aligned the Asset Health Index with existing site maintenance strategies.

experience.role: Labour Benchmarking Review · Data & Reporting Analyst
bullets: Built a national database of labour quantity information to draw conclusions on industry standards.
Broke each site down into major assets using exports from multiple sources, enabling like-for-like comparison.
Maintained direct client engagement to keep scope aligned with the desired outcomes.
Built reports and collated large datasets using appendices and supporting tools to improve readability.
Performed substation site validation and checked regulatory precautions in low-voltage substations.
Developed replacement recommendations from historical costing and asset changeout analysis.

experience.role: Asset Management Uplift Programme (Asset Tactics Review) · Graduate Team Member
bullets: Defect elimination Bad actor review identifying the worst-performing site assets by downtime and criticality.
Work management SAP PM01, PM02 and PM03 changeout analysis to find incomplete changeouts and causes of unnecessary downtime.
Maintenance strategy documentation PRT and task description review to find gaps and missing information.

experience.role: Closed Work Order and Parts Reallocation · Storefront
experience.dates: November 2022 - March 2024 · part time / ad hoc
bullets: Used SAP to re-issue unfitted stock items from maintenance orders back into the storefront and prepare work orders for fitters and maintenance crews.
Associated parts with SAP IDs, assembled service kits, ran stocktakes and adjusted SAP accordingly.

bullets: Built a web-based chatbot answering student questions from a UWA document set.
Combined an HTML, CSS and JavaScript front end with Python integration to cloud-hosted AI services.
Presented the project to the UWA Software Engineering board for a 90% overall project mark.
